title: First came GCash, Maya next? MVP eyes 2027 IPO
summary: Following the historic stock market debut of GCash parent Mynt, PLDT Inc. Chairman Manuel V. Pangilinan said Wednesday he is also looking to take fintech giant Maya public next year.
